disk_guardrail.action: No source download or bulk ingestion was attempted; this artifact uses existing local metadata only.

bottom_line.summary: Swiss-Prot/UniProt EC/Rhea, Rhea reaction mappings, CARD/AMRFinder-style AMR enzyme classes, and CAZy/BRENDA-like family or reaction annotations can plausibly seed bronze retrieval/training labels, but the current repo does not contain bulk local source mirrors. M-CSA and external expert panels must remain gold/silver evaluation surfaces.
not_supported: No full-source scale claim is supported from this run.
No label import or registry promotion is authorized.

No source prose, protein names, EC labels, Rhea identifiers, CARD family names, AMRFinder classes, BRENDA text, or CAZy family names may be used as predictive features for gold/silver performance claims.

bronze_label_schema.purpose: Represent source-derived labels as weak training/retrieval signal with explicit provenance, leakage controls, and abstention handling.

required_fields.description: Stable id derived from source, source release/version, source record id, entity id, and normalized label target.
Exact release, db_version, retrieval date, or immutable digest. Missing release blocks count claims.
UniProt accession, Rhea id, EC record, CARD ARO id, AMRFinder family id, CAZy family, BRENDA EC/organism key, or source-native record id.
Protein, sequence, structure, family, or reaction entity the weak label attaches to.
Reviewed/unreviewed, UniProt evidence codes, CARD/AMRFinder model type, BRENDA literature/kinetic provenance, CAZy curated family assignment, or Rhea reaction-record provenance.
Normalized EC number, depth, partial-EC flag, and whether the EC was direct source evidence or inferred through a crosswalk.
Rhea id, direction, equation hash, participant normalization status, and EC/Rhea crosswalk method.
Substrate/product/cofactor class labels, ChEBI-normalized participants if available, and mapping confidence.
Experimental PDB, predicted AlphaFold, no structure, ligand/cofactor/metal context, residue mapping status, and coordinate quality notes.
Sequence present locally, source accession, reviewed status, length, canonical/isoform handling, and cluster ids.
Mechanism family/fingerprint candidate, mapping rule id, direct/indirect mapping, confidence, counterevidence, and review-only flags.
Overlap with M-CSA/gold rows, external panels, source prose/name/EC leakage flags, sequence/structure/family cluster overlap, and split eligibility.
Positive, near_negative, out_of_scope, unknown, ambiguous_family, partial_ec_only, no_sequence, no_structure, or source_conflict.

minimum_acceptance_for_bronze_train_or_r: entity id and source record id are stable
sequence availability is known or explicitly not required for the task
any EC/Rhea/family mapping is marked direct vs inferred
M-CSA/gold/silver overlap and family-cluster overlap are checked before split assignment
source text/name/prose/EC/Rhea/family strings are stored as labels/provenance, not predictive features for gold/silver claims
unknown and out-of-scope records are preserved rather than silently dropped

scale_estimates.policy: Only counts verified from local committed artifacts are reported as numeric counts. Full-source scale is marked not_locally_verifiable.

gold_eval: M-CSA expert/curated mechanism labels and exact local active-site evidence remain gold for mechanism evaluation.
Human/expert-reviewed external panels remain gold/silver only when preregistered and source-independent.
silver_eval: External panels with frozen source-free geometry, duplicate screening, UniRef/current-reference screening, and explicit human review can be silver evaluation.
Silver rows cannot be selected using the same source labels being evaluated.
bronze_train_or_retrieval: Swiss-Prot/UniProt EC/Rhea, Rhea reaction mappings, BRENDA-like EC/substrate records, CARD/AMRFinder family labels, and CAZy family labels may train weak models or populate retrieval indexes only after release/version/digest capture.
Bronze labels cannot be included in primary gold/silver test metrics.
allowed_predictive_features_for_gold_cla: sequence-derived features that do not expose source labels or names
ligand/cofactor/metal context from coordinates under preregistered rules
learned embeddings if split leakage checks and source-label ablations pass
split_requirements: Deduplicate by exact entity id, canonical sequence, structure id, and source cross-reference before splitting.
Hold out M-CSA/gold/silver entities from all bronze training labels and retrieval indexes used for evaluation, unless the bronze index is explicitly declared train-only and not queried at eval time.
Use UniRef or equivalent sequence-cluster separation where available; otherwise mark split as weak and qualitative.
Use structure-neighborhood or Foldseek/TM cluster checks for structure-based claims.
Family/fingerprint holdout must be defined before source ingestion when measuring generalization beyond known families.
Run source-label ablations: performance claims must survive removal of EC/Rhea/CARD/AMRFinder/BRENDA/CAZy text identifiers from features.
oos_unknown_policy: Unknown source labels remain unknown_abstain, not negative.
Partial EC, broad CAZy family, or ambiguous CARD/AMRFinder hierarchy labels stay review_prior_only unless a direct mechanism mapping exists.
Out-of-scope and near-negative lanes are preserved for abstention calibration.
